Subject: Quick question on onboarding for pilot (W9 attached)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Apex team is excited to run the two-week pilot next month. Our procurement team is asking for a PO to be issued before we can send the first invoice, but we have an internal approval backlog and won’t be able to issue one in time.

Is Redwood able to onboard us and accept an invoice-only flow for the initial pilot (invoice sent 30 days after delivery)? I’ve attached our W9 and the vendor intake form our finance team asked for.

If a temporary exception helps, we can sign the SOW and provide a corporate credit card up front. Please let me know what you need from us to move forward this week.

Thanks,

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Apex’s request. Short summary: 2-week pilot, estimated invoice ~$9,500, vendor has provided W9 and intake form (attached). Apex can sign SOW but procurement cannot issue a PO before the pilot start date. They’re asking for a temporary invoice-only onboarding so billing can invoice post-delivery.

Questions for procurement: 
- Is there an established temporary path for low-dollar pilots (~<$10k) that allows onboarding without a PO if we collect the SOW + W9 + insurance?
- What approvals (manager or finance VP) are needed to authorize a one-off exception and how do we document it?

I’ve also attached a draft SOW (SOW_draft-Apex.pdf) we can use. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick question on onboarding for pilot (W9 attached)

Thanks for the context, Alex. Short answer: we do have a documented temporary invoice-only path for pilot engagements, but it requires capturing a few evidentiary items and an approval at the manager level (Finance Ops / Procurement). Policy summary below: 

- Eligibility: pilot total < $10,000 AND vendor is not providing services that require indemnity changes or high-risk data access.
- Required evidence: current W9, fully completed vendor intake form, signed SOW or purchase acceptance email, and confirmation of vendor banking details.
- Approval: Procurement manager sign-off (Marissa or delegated) + Finance Ops acknowledgement (Laura).
- Duration: invoice-only path limited to 60 days; subsequent work must either have a PO or a Contract Amendment.

For Apex specifically: their materials look complete from a paperwork standpoint. Two asks before I can sign off: 
1) Confirm the expected pilot invoice amount (Alex — you noted ~$9.5k, please confirm).
2) Confirm there is no need for custom indemnity / data residency terms in the SOW (legal would escalate if present).

If both checks pass I can approve the temporary onboarding today and I’ll add a procurement exception note to the vendor record.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ellie Park <ellie@apexsys.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick question on onboarding for pilot (W9 attached)

Adding a quick finance perspective: if the pilot invoice is <= $10k and there’s a signed SOW, Finance can accept an invoice-only flow for the first payment as a one-time exception provided Procurement documents the exception and we capture the billing contact and remit-to address on file. A couple operational notes: 

- Billing should receive invoices addressed to: Redwood Inference, AP Invoices <ap-invoices@redwood.com> with Apex’s remit-to details.
- We should create a temporaRy vendor code flagged as "invoice-only pilot" in the ERP so payments can be processed without a formal PO for 60 days.
- Finance will require the SOW to include the payment terms (Net 30) and a clause that the engagement will require a PO for follow-on work.

If Marissa can add the procurement exception to the vendor record I’ll have Finance put the temporary vendor code in the system today. If you’d like, I can draft the short exception memo for our audit trail.

—Priyom
Director, Finance Operations
priyom@redwood.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Ellie, confirmed invoice expectation is $9,500 (single invoice for the pilot). Per procurement/finance, next steps are: 

1) Ellie — please sign the attached SOW and send the final signed copy back to ap-invoices@redwood.com (cc me).
2) Send the invoice to ap-invoices@redwood.com with Apex’s remit-to banking details. Finance will create a temporary vendor code and process payment under the 60-day invoice-only exception.
3) Marissa — if you can add the procurement exception note and confirm when the vendor code is added, we’ll mark the account as active for the pilot.

I’ll also ask Legal to scan the SOW for any indemnity/data clauses but we don’t anticipate issues. Laura — flagging you for awareness.

Ellie — copying the billing address and SOW for clarity. Thanks again — excited to get the pilot live next week.

Best,
